iacPage.title: Infrastructure as Code examples for AWS
iacPage.subtitle: CloudFormation templates ready to study, download, and adapt. Select a file to see the technical explanation and use the file link to download it.
iacPage.quickStartText: Public VPC, Auto Scaling Group, Application Load Balancer, and EC2 instances with health checks.
iacPage.filtersHelp: Show all templates or focus on Auto Scaling and Load Balancer.

autoScaling.label: Auto Scaling
autoScaling.title: Diagram and explanation of AutoScaling1.yaml
autoScaling.shortDescription: Public VPC with two subnets and two EC2 instances managed by Auto Scaling.
autoScaling.description: This CloudFormation template creates a public VPC with two subnets in different availability zones and runs an Auto Scaling Group with two EC2 instances using a Launch Template. The Security Group attached to the Launch Template is automatically applied to the created EC2 instances.
highlights: If an EC2 instance stops responding, another one is created automatically; you can test this by terminating one of the created EC2 instances.
The Security Group attached to the Launch Template is automatically propagated to the EC2 instances.

loadBalancerAutoScaling.label: Load Balancer + Auto Scaling
loadBalancerAutoScaling.title: Diagram and explanation of LoadBalancerAutoScaling1.yaml
loadBalancerAutoScaling.shortDescription: Auto Scaling with Application Load Balancer, Target Group, and health checks.
loadBalancerAutoScaling.description: This CloudFormation template creates a public VPC with two subnets in different availability zones, runs an Auto Scaling Group with two EC2 instances using a Launch Template, and adds an Application Load Balancer.
loadBalancerAutoScaling.similarSuffix: , but adds the Application Load Balancer.
securityGroups: One Security Group for the Load Balancer, allowing HTTP access from the internet.
Another Security Group for the EC2 instances launched by the Auto Scaling Group, allowing SSH and HTTP from the ALB.
sshNotes: If the source is Windows, the YAML is already prepared because it uses KeyFormat: ppk.
If the source is Linux or Mac, change KeyFormat: ppk to KeyFormat: pem in the YAML.
loadBalancerAutoScaling.keyPairIntro: Use these commands to write minha-key-for-launch-template.ppk or minha-key-for-launch-template.pem, depending on the source.
loadBalancerAutoScaling.instanceIpIntro: After deployment, run the command below to list the running EC2 instances.
highlights: You can have more than one Security Group, each with different settings.
An EC2 instance can have a startup script that runs only once when the instance is created.
The Target Group uses health checks to keep only healthy instances behind the Load Balancer.
